title: Excess ethanol in petrol fuels protests and air pollution disrupts south India after Diwali

ai.summary: Protests in south India after Diwali due to excess ethanol in petrol and air pollution, with Karnataka and Kerala reporting fuel sample collections and Chennai facing smog disruptions.

facts.claim: Excess ethanol in petrol fuels protests and air pollution disrupts south India after Diwali
facts.quote: Excess ethanol in petrol fuels protests and air pollution disrupts south India after Diwali

facts.claim: Tensions rose in Karnataka and Kerala over claims of excessive ethanol blending in commercial petrol
facts.quote: Tensions rose in Karnataka and Kerala over claims of excessive ethanol blending in commercial petrol, with levels reported above the mandated limit, triggering protests and fuel sample collections.

facts.claim: Post-Diwali, Chennai faced severe air pollution and smog disruptions, causing match postponements
facts.quote: Post-Diwali, Chennai faced severe air pollution and smog disruptions, causing match postponements.

facts.claim: Hyderabad reported multiple cracker-related eye injuries amid moderate air quality

facts.claim: Tamil Nadu saw heightened political unrest following Diwali homicides, including a police officer's death
